rationale: The portfolio requires indexable multi-page content, static prerendering, metadata, and dynamic project routes.
React Three Fiber and Animate UI share one React runtime without an Astro island boundary around the primary homepage experience.
Next.js Route Handlers keep OpenRouter credentials server-only without adding a separate Express deployment.
Local typed content avoids CMS cost and operational complexity for v1 while preserving a later migration path.
Vercel is the curated WebDesigner deployment target for Next.js; deployment remains unconfigured until the release phase.
The approved mainUI.png reference makes an additional design-generation provider unnecessary, so the outline path is selected.
